During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]] was '''attacked''' by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] run.

==Prelude==
The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Control (CR90 corvette)|''Control'']] along with three [[Alpha Squadron]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] were ordered to attack an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to restore the Republic]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]]. Alpha 1's objective was to order his wingmen to take out certain craft to speed up the process of destroying the outpost. The ships would then return to the ''Control''.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Battle==
Alpha Squadron TIE bombers made their way towards the outpost. The outpost itself consisted of a group of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], owned by ''[[Enouck]]'' group and ''[[Xarxis]]'' group, four [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s, ''[[Axet]]'' group, two [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s, ''[[T-ST]]'' and ''[[T-SP]]'', and two groups of [[Class-A cargo container]]s, ''[[Vic]]'' and ''[[Limi]]''. If Alpha 1 was to run out of warheads, the transport ''[[Walker 1]]'' would arrive to reload the craft if needed. Four [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|assault gunboats]] would also serve as reinforcements if requested.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

During the attack, ''T-ST'' and ''T-SP'' attempted to board one of the containers, but were destroyed. As the ships fought on, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter]]s exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and attacked the TIE bombers. Later, three [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] also joined in. Transport group ''Axet'' would attack the corvette ''Control'', but they were all destroyed by Alpha Squadron. After the entire outpost were destroyed, the TIE bombers retreated back to the ''Control''.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Aftermath==
After this, three TIE bombers would conduct an attack on a Rebel storage yard with [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. This mission would also be featured in the Galactic Empire's combat training sequences so pilot's could test their skills with the [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] warhead. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] would eventually assume the role of Alpha 1 in the simulation during his combat training.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bombing of the Rebel outpost first appeared in the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] directed by [[David Wessman]]. It is the third combat training mission for the TIE bomber, titled "Torpedo Run".

The player can optionally inspect the craft of the outpost to achieve bonus goals.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />
